notes:
WaveShift 0.1.1 (build 26)

New in the editor:
- Tempo lane: pick Tempo ±% in the lane menu and draw a deck's pitch with points.
- Tempo ramp: glide a clip from one BPM to another.
- Edit Beat FX and Sound Color FX after the set: move, resize, switch type or delete them.
- Snap clip edges and points to the beat grid (hold Alt to drag freely).
- Browse for a set file anywhere on your PC from Open session.
- Timeline scrollbar.

Also:
- The version and build number show in settings. Please quote them in bug reports.
- WaveShift now tells you when a new version is out (you can turn this off in settings).
- Fixed an error when splitting a clip, and the waveform no longer stretches while a trimmed clip updates.
